_comment: P7 task 10 calibration set 3/4 -- sentiment. Labelled against the real, current production Sentiment type: chatbot.features.chat.models.Sentiment = Literal['positive','neutral','negative','urgent'] (widened to 4 levels by P7 task 1; see task-1-report.md). 'urgent' is safety-critical and, per detection.py's should_open_ticket, joins the ticket-creation gate -- so this set deliberately includes genuinely safety-critical urgent cases (brake failure, fire/smoke, accident, injury), not merely 'very negative' ones, so the two are distinguishable.
